mapper.select: select id, object_type, object_id, from_status, to_status, operator_id, reason, trace_id, create_time, del_flag from lab_status_history where id = #{historyId} and del_flag = '0'

with scoped_role_user as ( select distinct l.id laboratory_id, u.user_id, r.role_key from lab_laboratory l join sys_user_role ur on 1=1 join sys_user u on u.user_id=ur.user_id and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id and r.status='0' and r.del_flag='0' where l.del_flag='0' and r.role_key in ('lab_manager','lab_safety_officer') and (r.data_scope='1' or (r.data_scope='2' and exists (select 1 from sys_role_dept rd where rd.role_id=r.role_id and rd.dept_id=l.dept_id)) or (r.data_scope='3' and l.dept_id=u.dept_id) or (r.data_scope='4' and exists (select 1 from sys_dept sd where sd.dept_id=l.dept_id and sd.status='0' and sd.del_flag='0' and (sd.dept_id=u.dept_id or find_in_set(u.dept_id,sd.ancestors)>0))) or (r.data_scope='5' and l.manager_id=u.user_id)) ), expected as ( select h.id history_id, concat('RESERVATION_',h.to_status) notification_type, r.applicant_id receiver_id from lab_status_history h join lab_reservation r on r.id=h.object_id and r.del_flag='0' where h.del_flag='0' and h.object_type='RESERVATION' and h.to_status<>'PENDING' union all select h.id, concat('RESERVATION_',h.to_status), s.user_id from lab_status_history h join lab_reservation r on r.id=h.object_id and r.del_flag='0' join lab_device d on d.id=r.device_id and d.del_flag='0' join scoped_role_user s on s.laboratory_id=d.laboratory_id and s.role_key='lab_manager' where h.del_flag='0' and h.object_type='RESERVATION' and h.to_status='PENDING' union all select h.id, concat('REPAIR_ORDER_',h.to_status), ro.assignee_id from lab_status_history h join lab_repair_order ro on ro.id=h.object_id and ro.del_flag='0' where h.del_flag='0' and h.object_type='REPAIR_ORDER' and h.to_status in ('WAIT_REPAIR','IN_PROGRESS') union all select h.id, concat('REPAIR_ORDER_',h.to_status), s.user_id from lab_status_history h join lab_repair_order ro on ro.id=h.object_id and ro.del_flag='0' join lab_device d on d.id=ro.device_id and d.del_flag='0' join scoped_role_user s on s.laboratory_id=d.laboratory_id and s.role_key='lab_manager' where h.del_flag='0' and h.object_type='REPAIR_ORDER' and h.to_status in ('WAIT_ASSIGN','WAIT_ACCEPTANCE') union all select h.id, concat('REPAIR_ORDER_',h.to_status), ro.reporter_id from lab_status_history h join lab_repair_order ro on ro.id=h.object_id and ro.del_flag='0' where h.del_flag='0' and h.object_type='REPAIR_ORDER' and h.to_status='CLOSED' union all select h.id, concat('REPAIR_ORDER_',h.to_status), ro.assignee_id from lab_status_history h join lab_repair_order ro on ro.id=h.object_id and ro.del_flag='0' where h.del_flag='0' and h.object_type='REPAIR_ORDER' and h.to_status='CLOSED' union all select h.id, concat('INSPECTION_TASK_',h.to_status), t.assignee_id from lab_status_history h join lab_inspection_task t on t.id=h.object_id and t.del_flag='0' where h.del_flag='0' and h.object_type='INSPECTION_TASK' and h.to_status='PENDING' union all select h.id, concat('INSPECTION_TASK_',h.to_status), s.user_id from lab_status_history h join lab_inspection_task t on t.id=h.object_id and t.del_flag='0' join scoped_role_user s on s.laboratory_id=t.laboratory_id and s.role_key='lab_safety_officer' where h.del_flag='0' and h.object_type='INSPECTION_TASK' and h.to_status='COMPLETED' union all select h.id, concat('HAZARD_',h.to_status), hz.owner_id from lab_status_history h join lab_hazard hz on hz.id=h.object_id and hz.del_flag='0' where h.del_flag='0' and h.object_type='HAZARD' and h.to_status<>'PENDING_REVIEW' union all select h.id, concat('HAZARD_',h.to_status), s.user_id from lab_status_history h join lab_hazard hz on hz.id=h.object_id and hz.del_flag='0' left join lab_device d on hz.target_type='DEVICE' and d.id=hz.target_id and d.del_flag='0' join scoped_role_user s on s.laboratory_id=case when hz.target_type='LABORATORY' then hz.target_id else d.laboratory_id end and s.role_key='lab_safety_officer' where h.del_flag='0' and h.object_type='HAZARD' and h.to_status='PENDING_REVIEW' ) select distinct e.history_id from expected e where e.receiver_id is not null and e.receiver_id>0 and not exists (select 1 from lab_message_delivery n where n.dedupe_key=concat('history:',e.history_id,':',e.notification_type,':',e.receiver_id)) order by e.history_id limit #{limit}

select h.id as id, h.object_type as objectType, h.object_id as objectId, h.from_status as fromStatus, h.to_status as toStatus, h.operator_id as operatorId, coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name, ''), u.user_name) as operatorName, h.reason as reason, h.trace_id as traceId, h.create_time as createTime from lab_status_history h left join sys_user u on u.user_id = h.operator_id and u.del_flag = '0' where h.object_type = #{objectType} and h.object_id = #{objectId} and h.del_flag = '0' order by h.create_time, h.id
